model: RISH DMCi touch-screen demand controller with TOD
applies_to: Rishabh RISH DMCi 96 x 96 mm touch-screen demand controllers with the optional RS-485 Modbus output, per interface definition DMAN-00IM-0578 Rev. A (09/16).
summary: The RISH DMCi is a panel demand controller that measures voltage, current, power, PF, energy and six kinds of demand and sheds non-priority loads through relays before a contracted demand is exceeded; it also keeps time-of-day (TOD) tariff data. Its optional RS-485 port speaks Modbus RTU and every value is an IEEE 754 float in two registers. This map covers the main measured values, demand, energy, RTC and current-zone TOD registers (30001-30199) and the main setup registers.

addressing.note: The interface definition prints 3X/4X numbers next to the hex start address (30001 = 00 00, 40019 = 00 12). Wire address = number - 30001 (FC04) or - 40001 (FC03/FC16); every row here was checked against its printed hex and parameter number.

source.title: Interface Definition RISH DMCi Touch Screen Demand Controller with TOD
source.pages: PDF pp. 6-11 (data format, examples, 3X table to 30199), pp. 46-54 (4X table and explanations), p. 62 (Table 8 set-up codes)

notes: The data-format table states IEEE 754 floats, most significant byte first, so word order is ABCD; 40041 can switch to reversed order.
Left out: harmonics (30201 onwards), the 31-day TOD zone-wise history, the TOD profile/season/holiday settings (40105 onwards) and relay and demand-profile settings.
No unit column is printed, so units are left blank.
Up to 20 parameters per read request.
Model number: Table 7 prints a default of 3482 while the 40099 explanation says 3490, so no fixed value is given.
Serial defaults come from Table 7: RS 485 set-up code 5 (9600 baud, no parity, 2 stop bits) and node address 1.

integration.summary: Read 30001-30072 for instantaneous values and 30073-30128 for energy and demand with FC04, decoding each pair as a big-endian float. Settings are floats in the 4X area written with FC16.
integration.enable: Modbus is an optional output. Set node address and baud/parity in the communication menu, or over Modbus at 40021 and 40019.
quirks: Reading or writing half a float returns exception 02.
Settings marked Wp need the password (40071) first if one is set.
setup: Defaults per Table 7: node address 1, set-up code 5 (9600 baud, no parity, 2 stop bits).
gotchas: Energy scaling depends on the energy resolution and digit-reset settings (40005, 40039).

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
